title: The Silent Prison
summary: Escaping the collapsing Silent Prison with Tae-Jun on his back, Ha-Jun uses the Chains of Ruin to shatter the anti-matter fortress and liberate thousands of captive demons.

panels.shot: rotunda ceiling cracking wide shot
panels.action: Massive structural fissures tear across the rotunda ceiling as the fortress foundation destabilizes.
panels.prose_en: Massive structural fissures tear across the rotunda ceiling as the fortress foundation destabilizes.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi kile ki neenv asthir hoti hai, rotunda chhat mein bade paimane par sanrachnatmak dararen fat jaati han.

panels.shot: belial breaking free from wall shouting curse
panels.action: Bleeding from his severed horn, Belial screams down from the crumbling balcony: 'You will never escape the Abyss!'

dialogue.speaker: belial
dialogue.text: ALARM SOUNDED! THE THREE DEMON LORDS ALREADY KNOW YOU ARE HERE!!

panels.prose_en: Bleeding from his severed horn, Belial screams down from the crumbling balcony: 'You will never escape the Abyss!'.
panels.prose_hi: Apne kate hue seeng se khoon bahte hue, beleal dhahti hui balcony se neeche chillata hai: 'tum kabhi bhi rasatal se nahin bachoge!'

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up with cold sovereign eyes
panels.action: Ha-Jun tightens his grip on Tae-Jun's legs: 'Unhe aane do. Main unka bhi intezaar kar raha hoon.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Lekin yeh prison aaj khatam hogi.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun tightens his grip on Tae-Jun's legs: 'Unhe aane do. Main unka bhi intezaar kar raha hoon.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne Tae-Jun ke pairon par apni pakad majboot kar li: 'unhe aane do. main unka bhi intjaar kar raha hun.'

panels.shot: ha-jun unleashing the chains of ruin downward
panels.action: Ha-Jun hurls the ends of the Chains of Ruin into the four primary anti-matter load-bearing pillars.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun hurls the ends of the Chains of Ruin into the four primary anti-matter load-bearing pillars.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne ruin ki janjeeron ke siron ko char prathmik anti-mater lod-asar stambhon mein fenk diya.

panels.shot: chains wrapping tightly around the four pillars
panels.action: The black gravitational chains coil around the colossal stone pillars like crushing anacondas.
panels.prose_en: The black gravitational chains coil around the colossal stone pillars like crushing anacondas.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal patthar ke khambhon ke charon or kali gurutvakarshan shrinkhalayen anaconda ko kuchalne ki tarah ghumti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun pulling chains with 50-ton sovereign strength
panels.action: With a roar of pure ancestral power, Ha-Jun yanks both chain links backward with all his might.
panels.prose_en: With a roar of pure ancestral power, Ha-Jun yanks both chain links backward with all his might.
panels.prose_hi: Shuddh patrik shakti ki dahaad ke sath, Ha-Jun apni puri takat se donon chain kadiyon ko peeche ki or khinchta hai.

panels.shot: all four load-bearing pillars shattering simultaneously
panels.action: The four massive pillars implode into dust; the entire 500-foot fortress begins pancaking downward.
panels.prose_en: The four massive pillars implode into dust; the entire 500-foot fortress begins pancaking downward.
panels.prose_hi: Char vishal stambh dhul mein mil gaye; pura 500 foot ka kila neeche ki or dhansna shuru ho jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun launching into supersonic vertical flight
panels.action: Ha-Jun's shadow wings beat with explosive force, rocketing straight up toward the collapsing ceiling.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's shadow wings beat with explosive force, rocketing straight up toward the collapsing ceiling.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke chhaya pankh visfotak shakti se takrate hue sidhe dhahti chhat ki or badhte han.

panels.shot: slashing ceiling with fang of abyss to create exit
panels.action: Ha-Jun swings the void dagger upward, cleanly slicing a 30-foot exit hole through the solid stone roof.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun swings the void dagger upward, cleanly slicing a 30-foot exit hole through the solid stone roof.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun shunya khanjar ko upar ki or ghumata hai, thos patthar ki chhat ke madhyam se 30 foot ke nikas chhed ko safai se kaatata hai.

panels.shot: bursting out onto the fortress roof into the open sky
panels.action: Ha-Jun bursts into the starry purple sky of the Abyss just as the entire fortress beneath him collapses.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun bursts into the starry purple sky of the Abyss just as the entire fortress beneath him collapses.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun rasatal ke taron bhare baingani aakash mein ud gaya, jaise hi uske neeche ka pura kila dhah gaya.

panels.shot: the 500-foot silent prison crumbling into the void below
panels.action: The monolithic fortress shears off the cliff, falling thousands of feet into the bottomless void below.
panels.prose_en: The monolithic fortress shears off the cliff, falling thousands of feet into the bottomless void below.
panels.prose_hi: Akhand kila chattan se katkar hajaron feet neeche athah shunya mein girta hai.

panels.shot: thousands of captive demon spirits floating free
panels.action: Thousands of luminous green and violet soul lights rise from the ruins, floating free into the purple sky.

dialogue.text: Hazaaron saalon se band qaidiyo ki aatmaayein... Azaad ho gayi.

panels.prose_en: Thousands of luminous green and violet soul lights rise from the ruins, floating free into the purple sky.
panels.prose_hi: Hajaron chamakdar hari aur baingani aatma ki roshni khandharon se nikalti hai, jo baingani aakash mein mukt roop se tairti hai.

panels.shot: liberated souls bowing to ha-jun in the sky
panels.action: The swirling cloud of glowing souls circles Ha-Jun like a celestial halo, bowing before flying free.
panels.prose_en: The swirling cloud of glowing souls circles Ha-Jun like a celestial halo, bowing before flying free.
panels.prose_hi: Chamkati aatmaon ka ghumta hua badal akashiya prabhamandal ki tarah Ha-Jun ke charon or chakkar lagata hai, aur mukt hokar udne se pehle jhuk jata hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun opening eyes on ha-jun back
panels.action: Tae-Jun watches the glowing souls with awe, resting his chin on Ha-Jun's shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun... Tumne sach mein unhe bacha liya. Tum sirf mere bhai nahi... Real King ban chuke ho.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun watches the glowing souls with awe, resting his chin on Ha-Jun's shoulder.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun chamakti aatmaon ko vismay ke saath dekhta hai, Ha-Jun ke kandhe par apni thuddi tikata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling gently as wind ruffles his hair
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles with quiet happiness: 'Maine jo bhi kiya... Bas aapko wapas paane ke liye kiya, Bhai.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles with quiet happiness: 'Maine jo bhi kiya... Bas aapko wapas paane ke liye kiya, Bhai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun shant khushi ke saath muskurata hai: 'maine jo bhi kiya... bus aapko wapas paane ke liye liya, bhai...'.

panels.shot: kuro flying beside them with happy caws
panels.action: Kuro glides playfully: 'Bohot emotional reunion ho gaya! Ab humein safe ground dhoondhna hoga!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun ko rest aur nourishment chahiye!

panels.prose_en: Kuro glides playfully: 'Bohot emotional reunion ho gaya! Ab humein safe ground dhoondhna hoga!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro chanchalta se bolta hai: 'bahut bhavnatmak punarmilan ho gaya! ab hamen safe ground dhundna hoga!'.

panels.shot: landing on a secluded floating crystal plateau
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands gently on a floating island carpeted with soft purple moss and clear freshwater springs.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lands gently on a floating island carpeted with soft purple moss and clear freshwater springs.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun naram baingani kai aur saaf meethe pani ke jharnon se saje ek tairte dweep par dheere se utarta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun gently laying tae-jun onto soft moss
panels.action: Ha-Jun helps his brother sit against a glowing crystalline tree trunk beside the spring.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun helps his brother sit against a glowing crystalline tree trunk beside the spring.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne bhai ko jharne ke paas ek chamakte crystaliy ped ke tane ke samne baithne mein madad karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun offering fresh spring water in cupped hands
panels.action: Ha-Jun scoops sweet, mana-rich spring water in his hands, helping Tae-Jun drink.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Phew... Yeh paani... Mana se bhara hua hai. Meri energy wapas aa rahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun scoops sweet, mana-rich spring water in his hands, helping Tae-Jun drink.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne hathon mein mitha, mana-samriddh jharne ka pani leta hai, jisse Tae-Jun ko peene mein madad milti hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun looking at ha-jun glowing relics
panels.action: Tae-Jun inspects the ring, bone gauntlet, chains, and dagger: 'Chheh Relics... Tumne 6 Relics claim kar liye?'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Feather, Ring, Bone, Heart, Fang, Chains... Aur right eye mein Eye of the Night!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun inspects the ring, bone gauntlet, chains, and dagger: 'Chheh Relics... Tumne 6 Relics claim kar liye?'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne anguthi, haddi ka gauntlet, janjeeron aur khanjar ka nirikshan kiya: 'chhe avshesh... tumne 6 avsheshon ka dawa kar liya?'.

panels.shot: ha-jun nodding: 'Four relics baaki hain.'
panels.action: Ha-Jun sits cross-legged beside him: 'Legendary Crown, Eclipse Devourer, aur Hourglass.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sits cross-legged beside him: 'Legendary Crown, Eclipse Devourer, aur Hourglass.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun uske bagal mein cross-legd baithta hai: 'legendari crown, aclips davoorer, aur ovarglas.'

panels.shot: tae-jun expression turning deeply serious
panels.action: Tae-Jun leans forward, his voice dropping to a grave whisper: 'Ha-Jun... Legendary Crown ke baare mein kuch janna zaroori hai.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Crown of the Sovereign... Wahan hai jahan First Sovereign ka throne tha: The Fallen Throne.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun leans forward, his voice dropping to a grave whisper: 'Ha-Jun... Legendary Crown ke baare mein kuch janna zaroori hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun aage ki or jhukta hai, uski awaz gambhir fusfusahat ki tarah hoti hai: 'Ha-Jun... legendary crown ke baare mein kuch janana jaruri hai.'

panels.shot: tae-jun explaining the crown's test
panels.action: Tae-Jun reveals: 'Crown ko pehanne par First Sovereign ki consciousness tumhare mind mein enter karegi.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Agar tumhara will kamzor hua, toh woh tumhari body par kabza kar lega. Tum 'tum' nahi rahoge.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun reveals: 'Crown ko pehanne par First Sovereign ki consciousness tumhare mind mein enter karegi.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne khulasa kiya: 'crown ko pahnoge par first Sovereign ki chetna tumhare man mein pravesh karegi.'

panels.shot: kuro looking down silently with ruffled feathers
panels.action: Kuro remains silent, confirming the terrifying risk with a quiet dip of his head.
panels.prose_en: Kuro remains silent, confirming the terrifying risk with a quiet dip of his head.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro chup rahata hai, chupchap sir jhukakar bhayanak khatre ki pushti karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking at his open hands
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks at his fingers, etched with scars and power: 'Main kisi ka puppet nahi banunga, Bhai.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main First Sovereign ka re-incarnation nahi hoon. Main Ha-Jun Kang hoon. Aur main apna destiny khud likhunga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks at his fingers, etched with scars and power: 'Main kisi ka puppet nahi banunga, Bhai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apni ungaliyon ko dekhta hai, jo nishan aur takat se bani han: 'main kisi ka kathputli nahin banunga, bhai.'

panels.shot: sudden eclipse shadow falling over the floating island
panels.action: The twin crimson moons in the sky suddenly plunge into total darkness; the purple sky turns black.
panels.prose_en: The twin crimson moons in the sky suddenly plunge into total darkness; the purple sky turns black.
panels.prose_hi: Aakash mein judwan lal chandrama achanak purna andhkar mein doob jaate han; baingani aakash kala ho jata hai.

panels.shot: temperature plummeting to sub-zero
panels.action: Frost instantly coats the purple moss; Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun's breath turns to thick white vapor.
panels.prose_en: Frost instantly coats the purple moss; Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun's breath turns to thick white vapor.
panels.prose_hi: Pala turant baingani kai ko dhak deta hai; Ha-Jun aur Tae-Jun ki saans gaadhe safed vashp mein badal jaati hai.

panels.shot: three titanic shadows manifesting in the sky
panels.action: In the blackened sky, three colossal phantom silhouettes—each 500 feet tall—slowly materialize.
panels.prose_en: In the blackened sky, three colossal phantom silhouettes—each 500 feet tall—slowly materialize.
panels.prose_hi: Kale aakash men, teen vishal pret akritiyan - pratyek 500 feet unchi - dhire-dhire sakar hoti han.

panels.shot: kuro screeching battle alarm in dread
panels.action: Kuro's eyes widen in dread: 'THE THREE DEMON LORDS! Unhone humein locate kar liya!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: MALGATH! VALAC! LILITH! THE ENTIRE ABYSS HAS COME FOR US!!

panels.prose_en: Kuro's eyes widen in dread: 'THE THREE DEMON LORDS! Unhone humein locate kar liya!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki aankhen bhay se fail gain: 'teen rakshas bhagwan! anhoni humne locate kar liya!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing defensively in front of his brother
panels.action: Ha-Jun draws both weapons, shadow wings expanding to block the freezing gale: 'Bhai mere peeche raho.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Let them come. I am not the frightened boy from the rooftop anymore.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun draws both weapons, shadow wings expanding to block the freezing gale: 'Bhai mere peeche raho.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun donon hathiyar khinchta hai, thandi aandhi ko rokne ke liye chhaya pankhon ka vistar karta hai: 'bhai mere peeche raho.'
